theorems.name: Submission.bf_coneMass_slab_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N) (s R : ℝ) (S : Set (Rn N)) (x : Rn N), 0 < s → (∃ y ∈ S, ‖P (y - x)‖ < s / 4 * ‖y - x‖) → (∀ y ∈ S, ‖y - x‖ ≤ R) → ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ h ≤ R ∧ ∃ x' ∈ S, S ∩ {z | ‖P (z - x)‖ < s * h / 4} ⊆ insert x ({y | ‖P (y - x)‖ < s * ‖y - x‖} ∩ Metric.ball x (3 * h) ∪ {y | ‖P (y - x')‖ < s * ‖y - x'‖} ∩ Metric.ball x' (3 * h))
